title: Generated AC1027 GEODATA adapter transport
scope: Bounded generation-keyed typed GEODATA capture, source CLASS/frame/common-owner binding, strict DXF output, transaction failure/retry, and fresh ASCII/Binary readback for a locally authored AC1027 DWG version-2 object.

fixture.artifacts: The test writes a temporary DWG and ASCII/Binary DXFs under the system temporary directory and removes them with RAII cleanup.

implementation.behavior: The adapter retains only bounded DWG-origin typed GEODATA keyed by import generation and source handle. Before output it requires complete unchanged CLASS evidence, a unique published canonical GEODATA class row, exact CLASS instance/raw-frame/typed-count agreement, a matching typed/raw class and common-owner binding, an unchanged owner-to-host relation, and one *Model_Space BLOCK_RECORD target. It registers the output CLASS, reserves source identities, writes selected objects, and records per-frame output qualification only after successful serialization.
limits: The output profile currently requires version 1 or 2, a model-space host equal to the common owner, no reactors, extension dictionary, EED or XDATA, and fields accepted by the low-level GEODATA writer.
A successful selected GEODATA frame does not qualify unrelated source frames or whole-document output.
Physical producer breadth, geospatial unit/projection meaning, native-consumer acceptance and complete document closure remain unqualified.

regressionControl.behavior: For ASCII and Binary DXF, an invalid host pointer is refused without changing sentinel destination bytes; the same adapter then retries successfully after correction. Fresh typed readback checks object identity and fields and resolves both the common owner and GEODATA host pointer to the emitted (remapped) *Model_Space BLOCK_RECORD.
regressionControl.outputQualification: The test checks the selected GEODATA source frame's output binding and does not assert whole-source opaque output qualification.
